newsitem.title: UK: BTR posts further gains, BZW repeats "buy".
newsitem.headline: BTR posts further gains, BZW repeats "buy".

text.p: Shares in industrial conglomerate BTR Plc continued their advance on Monday, supported by a reiteration of a "buy" stance by the company's brokers, BZW. The shares were up 7p at 283p by 1146 GMT. Last week the group reported a 13.4 percent decline in 1996 profits but the shares rose amid perceptions that BTR's reorganisation will soon begin to pay off. Market sources said BZW commented that the current rating more than discounts concerns over future profit growth and longer term prospects look encouraging. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 4027
